# Boot file for the VM smoke test (test/vm-smoke.sh). It is copied to the EFI partition
# of a COPY of the image. The test checks that the host name is set and that the
# password is masked in emulationstation.txt.applied.
# HOSTNAME must be in TLS_EXTRA_SANS of test/fixtures/build.conf.smoke.
HOSTNAME=emulationstation-smoke
TIMEZONE=Europe/Berlin
# Same value as USER_PASSWORD in build.conf.smoke, so the SSH login still works.
USER_PASSWORD=smoke-test-password
